data.name: Mehuli
data.gender_notes: Mehuli is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mehuli is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mohana', meaning 'moon'. The name signifies the gentle and soothing light of the moon. It is also said to mean 'pleasing' or 'gracious'. The name Mehuli carries the meaning “Moonlight, Pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mehuli usually hope their child will grow to embody moonlight, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine light of the moon and the inner light of wisdom and knowledge.

data.cultural_impact: Mehuli is a popular name in the Indian subcontinent, particularly in the states of Bengal and Assam. It is believed that naming a child after celestial bodies like the Moon, Sun, or Stars, bestows upon them certain god-given qualities. In the case of Mehuli, it is believed that children with this name will possess a gentle and soothing demeanor, similar to the calming effect of the moon.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the moon is considered the embodiment of Soma, the divine drink of the gods. It is also believed that the moon was created from the goddess Kali's tears, signifying the divine feminine energy. Thus, the name Mehuli, meaning moon, holds spiritual significance as it symbolizes the connection between the divine feminine, calmness, and the natural world. It is also believed that the name calls forth the inner peace and tranquility that is associated with the moon.
